name: Poznań Citizens' Panel
content: Problems and Purpose Poznań assembly brought together 80 randomly selected residents from across Poznań city between September and November 2019, to figure out, how can the Poznań authorities act to counteract and adapt to climate change and the climate crisis. Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Participant Recruitment and Selection Households are drawn from the full pool of apartment addresses in Poznań, taking into account all housing estates.Letter invitations to participate in the panel are sent to the selected addresses. Methods and Tools Used What Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation The course of the panel includes two basic parts: educational and deliberative.During educational meetings, panelists and panellists explore the topic of the panel and its individual thematic threads.This is when it is time for experts and parties to speak, and for question and answer sessions.It is also the part of the process that is generally available to all interested parties, in the form of broadcasts, recordings or information materials. The educational part is followed by a series of deliberative meetings.Influence, Outcomes, and Effects The whole thing ends with a vote.Recommendations, which will be supported by at least 80 percent of panellists and panellists, will be indicated for implementation and submitted to the Poznań City Council by the Mayor of the City.
